description: UKORUL crystallizes in the monoclinic crystal system with space group C 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: C104 H83 Gd3 N8 O17,C1 H2 Cl2. From the CIF bond table, Gd1 (Gd) has 6 O neighbors; Gd2 (Gd) has 8 O neighbors; Gd3 (Gd) has 6 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 2 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a chain with approximately linear metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.005-4.005 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.67-117.45°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Gd3(L1)2(dbm)5(CH3OH)]·CH2Cl2 (C104H83Gd3N8O17·CH2Cl2); L1 = 6-(hydroxymethyl)-N'-[(1E)-(6-methoxypyridin-2-yl)methylidene]pyridine-2-carbohydrazide; Hdbm = 1,3-diphenylpropane-1,3-dione.
